// TEMPORARY diagnostics for the hosted runners (removed before the pull request merges). Prints
// facts only: times, counts, exit codes, drive letters and types.
import { spawn, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import {
  closeSync,
  fsyncSync,
  mkdtempSync,
  openSync,
  readdirSync,
  realpathSync,
  rmSync,
  writeSync,
} from "node:fs";
import { createServer, request } from "node:http";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite";

const windows = process.platform === "win32";
const out = (label: string, value: unknown) =>
  console.log(`[diag] ${label}: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);
const ms = (t0: number) => Math.round(performance.now() - t0);

function flush(dir: string, label: string) {
  const d = mkdtempSync(join(dir, "diag-flush-"));
  try {
    const f = join(d, "f.bin");
    const fd = openSync(f, "w");
    const times: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      writeSync(fd, Buffer.alloc(100, i));
      fsyncSync(fd);
      times.push(performance.now() - t0);
    }
    closeSync(fd);
    times.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    out(
      `${label} fsync ms p50/p90/max`,
      [times[25], times[45], times[49]].map((x) => Math.round((x ?? 0) * 100) / 100),
    );
    const db = new DatabaseSync(join(d, "x.db"));
    db.exec("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA synchronous=FULL; CREATE TABLE t (v TEXT)");
    const ins = db.prepare("INSERT INTO t VALUES (?)");
    let t0 = performance.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
      db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE");
      ins.run("x".repeat(200));
      db.exec("COMMIT");
    }
    out(`${label} sqlite FULL 200 commits ms`, ms(t0));
    db.exec("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL");
    t0 = performance.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
      db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE");
      ins.run("x".repeat(200));
      db.exec("COMMIT");
    }
    out(`${label} sqlite NORMAL 200 commits ms`, ms(t0));
    db.close();
  } finally {
    rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

async function linuxBind() {
  // A server that closed its side first leaves TIME_WAIT on its port: can python bind it?
  const server = createServer((_q, s) => s.end("ok"));
  await new Promise<void>((r) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", r));
  const port = (server.address() as { port: number }).port;
  await new Promise<void>((r) => {
    request({ host: "127.0.0.1", port, path: "/", agent: false }, (res) => {
      res.resume();
      res.on("end", r);
    }).end();
  });
  server.closeAllConnections();
  await new Promise<void>((r) => server.close(() => r()));
  for (const reuse of [false, true]) {
    const py = spawnSync(
      "python3",
      [
        "-c",
        `import socket\ns=socket.socket()\n${reuse ? "s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)\n" : ""}s.bind(("127.0.0.1", ${port}))\ns.listen()\nprint("listening")`,
      ],
      { encoding: "utf8" },
    );
    out(`python bind after a closed server, reuse=${reuse}`, {
      status: py.status,
      out: py.stdout.trim(),
      err: py.stderr.trim().split("\n").at(-1),
    });
  }
  const ss = spawnSync("ss", ["-tan", `sport = :${port}`], { encoding: "utf8" });
  out("ss rows on that port", ss.stdout.trim().split("\n").length - 1);
}

async function windowsChecks() {
  const { windowsElevated, system32 } = await import("../../packages/service/src/hub/identity.ts");
  out("elevated", windowsElevated());
  const tmp = tmpdir();
  out("tmpdir has a short name", tmp.includes("~"));
  out("drives: tmpdir, its real path, cwd", [
    tmp.slice(0, 2),
    realpathSync.native(tmp).slice(0, 2),
    process.cwd().slice(0, 2),
  ]);
  const ps = join(
    system32() ?? "C:\\Windows\\System32",
    "WindowsPowerShell",
    "v1.0",
    "powershell.exe",
  );
  const base = ["-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive"];
  const minimal: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(process.env)) {
    if (
      v !== undefined &&
      /^(SYSTEMROOT|WINDIR|SYSTEMDRIVE|TEMP|TMP|USERPROFILE|USERNAME|PATH|PATHEXT|COMSPEC)$/i.test(
        k,
      )
    )
      minimal[k] = v;
  }
  const { REGISTRY_SCRIPT } = await import("../../packages/launch/src/environment/layers.ts");
  const run = (label: string, args: string[], env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv) => {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const r = spawnSync(ps, args, { env, encoding: "utf8", windowsHide: true, timeout: 120_000 });
    out(label, { ms: ms(t0), status: r.status, bytes: r.stdout.length });
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    run(`bare ${i}`, [...base, "-Command", "[Console]::Out.Write('x')"], process.env);
    run(`convertto-json full env ${i}`, [...base, "-Command", "ConvertTo-Json 1"], process.env);
    run(`convertto-json minimal env ${i}`, [...base, "-Command", "ConvertTo-Json 1"], minimal);
    run(
      `registry script minimal env ${i}`,
      [...base, "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", REGISTRY_SCRIPT],
      minimal,
    );
    run(
      `get-childitem hkcu ${i}`,
      [...base, "-Command", "Get-ChildItem HKCU:\\Environment | Out-Null"],
      process.env,
    );
  }
  const modules = (process.env["PSModulePath"] ?? "")
    .split(";")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((p) => {
      try {
        return readdirSync(p).length;
      } catch {
        return -1;
      }
    });
  out("modules per PSModulePath entry", modules);
  const { realSyncHost } = await import("../../packages/service/src/hub/sync-host.ts");
  const { checkFolder } = await import("../../packages/service/src/hub/sync-folders.ts");
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const facts = await realSyncHost().windowsFacts();
    out(`sync facts ${i}`, {
      ms: ms(t0),
      ok: facts !== undefined,
      drives: facts?.drives.map((d) => [
        d.root,
        d.type,
        d.format,
        d.label === "" ? "" : "labelled",
      ]),
    });
  }
  const t1 = performance.now();
  const parallel = await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: 8 }, async () => {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const facts = await realSyncHost().windowsFacts();
      return [ms(t0), facts !== undefined];
    }),
  );
  out("sync facts, 8 at once", { total: ms(t1), each: parallel });
  const t2 = performance.now();
  const bare = await Promise.all(
    Array.from(
      { length: 8 },
      () =>
        new Promise<number>((resolve) => {
          const t0 = performance.now();
          const c = spawn(ps, [...base, "-Command", "[Console]::Out.Write('x')"], {
            stdio: "ignore",
            windowsHide: true,
          });
          c.on("close", () => resolve(ms(t0)));
        }),
    ),
  );
  out("bare, 8 at once", { total: ms(t2), each: bare });
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmp, "diag-check-"));
  try {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const check = await checkFolder(dir, realSyncHost());
    out("checkFolder(tmp)", {
      ms: ms(t0),
      verdict: check.verdict,
      rules: check.signals.map((s) => s.rule),
    });
  } finally {
    rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

out("platform", process.platform);
flush(tmpdir(), "os temp");
if (process.env["RUNNER_TEMP"] !== undefined) flush(process.env["RUNNER_TEMP"], "runner temp");
if (windows) await windowsChecks();
else await linuxBind();
